title: Honey-Glazed Moroccan Minari Robata-Grilled Chebakia
description: A sweet and snappy Moroccan dish featuring minari, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Minari adds a delicious crunch to traditional chebakia.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt.
Mix the dough until it comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the minari into 1-inch pieces.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into diamond shapes.
Place a few pieces of minari on each diamond shape, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the dough with honey, and sprinkle with rose water, ginger, and cinnamon.
Brush the edges of the dough with water.
Fold the dough over the minari, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the chebakia on the preheated robata grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Brush with ghee or vegetable oil.
Repeat with the remaining dough and minari.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar.
